summary: Review commercial agreements, identify clause risks, and prepare clear escalation briefs. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Commercial contract law training helps procurement, sales and contract professionals review routine agreements and flag issues for legal escalation. Participants practise mapping obligations, interpreting terms, assessing liability and delivery clauses, and preparing review matrices and negotiation priorities, with an overview of the UNIDROIT Principles, the CISG and Incoterms 2020; these international references do not replace checking applicable local law.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who encounter commercial agreements in daily purchasing, sales, supplier management, or legal support and need a disciplined way to identify issues and route them for review.
prerequisites: No prior contract-law qualification is required. Familiarity with workplace purchasing, sales, supplier relationships, or service agreements will help you apply the exercises.
